_help.about: (26 Oct) The world gets ready for dawn and dusk. Every routine fires on the local sun's elevation (the one shared sky, §GK.1.2; was the place's latitude, §GE.5), never a clock hour; each actor adds a random offset so the change spreads across the twilight. First guesses by Claude (chat); Mike tunes by play. Wired 26 Oct (queue 115, DayShift).
_help.sun_deg: Sun elevations (degrees) that start and finish the evening change (start > end) and the morning change (start < end). The 18-minute dusk and dawn of §GE sit inside these.
_help.flowers: bloom habits; tagged plants keep their tag, the rest default to always. open_close_s is real seconds for a flower to open or close.
_help.creatures: shift = day | night | twilight. Creatures without a tag default by kind (birds day, bats/owls/moths night, deer twilight).
_help.folk_lights: keepers light their own lights in turn at dusk; per_light_gap_s spreads them; at dawn they put them out, the hearth banked not out.
_help.crawler: (queue 115, Claude Code) The crawler's own numbers for the routines: night_bloomer_clumps how many clumps of moonflower and datura stand about the hub; birds the day flock that roosts at dusk; bats the colony that leaves the stair mouth (a ruin entrance) at dusk and returns at dawn; moths_per_light how many moths at each night bloomer clump and lit torch; hearth_banked the hearth's share of its light by day (banked, not out), hearth_change_s how long the cook-shaman takes to build it up or bank it; walk_mps the keepers' walking pace on their rounds.
